notes: This series shows the rapid growth of Broadcom's custom AI accelerator (non-merchant chip) business -- the same business line the bullet's $60 billion bank financing and Anthropic's $125.2 billion commitment are meant to fund capacity for. All four figures are actual reported quarterly results (not guidance) quoted verbatim from Broadcom's own earnings-announcement articles as republished/reported on finance.yahoo.com, each a separate article URL on the same site. Q4 FY2025 ($6.5 billion, ~74% YoY, reported Dec 2025) exists as a published actual figure but I could not confirm it on a finance.yahoo.com page within budget, so it was left out rather than guessed. Figures published only as forward guidance (e.g. the Q4 FY2026 $21.7 billion and FY2026/FY2027/FY2028 outlook figures) were excluded per the no-forecast rule. Did not use qz.com, cnbc.com (403 blocked), fool.com (listed as blocked), sec.gov (listed as blocked), or investors.broadcom.com (repeated timeouts/connection resets when fetched directly, suggesting it would also fail an automated-reader check).
